message.content:
A folding utility knife with a replaceable blade. Candidates are heading 8208 (replaceable blades for hand-operated tools), 8211 (knives with cutting blades, other than 8208), and 9602 (no).

Heading 8211 covers pocket knives and other knives with cutting blades, including folding knives. Within it, 8211.92 covers other knives having fixed blades, and 8211.93 covers knives having other than fixed blades, which includes folding knives. 8211.93.00 has statistical suffixes: 8211.93.0030 for pocket knives, jack knives and similar folding knives with a handle of base metal; 8211.93.0060 for other. I recall these may be 8211.93.0030 "Penknives, pocketknives...", 8211.93.0060 "Other". Utility knives with a replaceable blade that fold are most likely classified under 8211.93.0090 as "other", though CBP rulings on folding utility knives with replaceable blades have also used 8211.93.00. The current schedule is 8211.93.00 with subheadings:
- 8211.93.00.30 – Pocketknives with one or more folding blades...
- 8211.93.00.60 – Other
- 8211.93.00.90 – ?

I'm not certain of the exact suffixes. A folding utility knife with a quick-change blade is a tool-like knife rather than a traditional pocketknife, so the "other" suffix fits best. I'll go with 8211.93.0090.
